title: Suspend-less reset: wifi reload and driver unload/reload
proves: Full teardown/re-probe paths (no system suspend) release everything: memory returns, FW reloads cleanly, no WMI/HTT timeouts on re-init.

setup.cmd: (for i in $(seq 1 60); do hostapd_cli -i {ap_if} status | grep -q state=ENABLED && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1)

loop.cmd: wifi down; rmmod {wifi_modules}; sleep 2; modprobe {wifi_modules}; wifi up
loop.placeholder: QSDK module names / load order (and NSS dependencies) vary; verify before enabling
